prompts.prepare: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original in-game football highlight still, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 if possible. High-detail modern retro PIXEL ART, premium late 16-bit / early 32-bit arcade sports illustration. Visible hard-edged deliberate pixel clusters on a consistent roughly 384x216 logical grid, 3-6 shades per material, nearest-neighbor enlarged look. No smooth painted rendering, no 3D, no photorealism, no chibi, no tiny generic sprites, no blur or excessive dithering. Scene: a fictional athletic male footballer with short dark curly hair, medium brown skin, a bold gold short-sleeve jersey with navy trim, navy shorts and gold socks, black boots. Full body substantial in foreground, seen from behind at a slight three-quarter angle, preparing a powerful shot with planted left foot beside a clearly readable black-and-white ball, right leg drawn back. Believable expressive anatomy and detailed limbs and kit folds. A goalkeeper in teal jersey and dark shorts waits in goal at upper center, no defender. Packed grand stadium, layered upper stands, colorful clustered spectators, banners without text, goal mesh, bright directional afternoon sun, rich green textured pitch with chalk and deep rich shadows. Strong anticipation pose frozen as a sports illustration. Composition will be shared with later goal/save/miss reaction panels. No UI, no lettering, no logos, no real teams or recognizable people, no watermark. Use the attached visual direction as style inspiration only; do not copy existing images.
